name: Enterprise Product Engineering and Manufacturing
constraints: Every BOM states kind and immutable version.
Every quantity carries unit and basis.
Every substitution carries applicability, effectivity and authority.
Drawing, SKU and serial remain distinct.
As-built composition derives only from actual events.
Occurrence identity is baseline-scoped.
Alternates are candidates, not installed components.
Firmware release is not a device or EBOM line.
Lot is not a serialized instance.
EBOM never becomes MBOM without an evidenced mapping.
Retired identifiers remain resolvable and are never reused.
SKU is a seller-scoped alias or variant qualifier and never identifies a serialized item or a design revision.
A priced sellable unit belongs to the separate Offering boundary.
Commercial substitution on WM-OBJ-002 and engineering component substitution in WM-OBJ-019 are distinct relations and never merged.
Occurrence identity is baseline-scoped and never global.
Firmware binding to a physical item is a deployment/installation occurrence with its own time and evidence.
Reuse of WM-OBJ-019 never implies MBOM.
No substitution is valid without a named approving authority and a bounded effectivity range.
A firmware release (WM-SFT-008) is neither a device nor an EBOM line nor a part number.
WM-SFT-012 is the SBOM record and never carries firmware-release identity.
WM-SFT-007 masters component/package identity; releases do not.
BOM occurrences are baseline-scoped and remain distinct even when displayed row numbers match; occurrence is not a root.
Alternates are candidates and are never summed as installed components.
holds: Base specifications remain reviewable drafts and mostly single-provider.
Firmware installation-occurrence model (cited as WM-SFT-009 by WM-SFT-008) is unsupplied.
CLASSIFIES is absent from the relation enum.
No publication or installability readiness is claimed.

effectivity.resolvability: A lotRange bound is unresolvable until the Lot/Batch master exists; it must be recorded as unresolved, never defaulted to satisfied.
